text.en:
This short tour shows you how to find an order and create a new one.

You can restart it at any time with the Guided Tour button in the header.
text.de: Diese kurze Tour zeigt, wie Sie Aufträge finden und neue anlegen.

steps.title: Search for orders
steps.text: Type a customer name or order number and press Enter.

steps.title: Your orders
steps.text: All orders you are responsible for. Click a row to see its details.

steps.title: Create an order
steps.text: Click Create to start a new sales order. Go ahead and try it now!

steps.title: Enter the details
steps.text: Fill in the customer and the net amount, then choose Save.

steps.title: Not on every screen
steps.text: Steps marked skipIfMissing are skipped when their element is not visible.
